en: Galatians 1

p.src: 1  Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

en: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
u.src: 1  Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

en: 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.

p.src: 2  and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

en: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
u.src: 2  and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

en: 1:2 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 3  Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

en: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
u.src: 3  Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

p.src: 4  who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

en: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
u.src: 4  who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

p.src: 5  to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

en: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
u.src: 5  to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

p.src: 6  I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

en: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
u.src: 6  I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

p.src: 7  but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

en: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
u.src: 7  but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

p.src: 8  But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

en: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
u.src: 8  But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

p.src: 9  As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

en: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
u.src: 9  As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

p.src: 10  For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

en: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
u.src: 10  For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

p.src: 11  But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

en: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
u.src: 11  But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

p.src: 12  For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

en: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
u.src: 12  For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

p.src: 13  For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

en: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.
u.src: 13  For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

p.src: 14  I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

en: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
u.src: 14  I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

p.src: 15  But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

en: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,
u.src: 15  But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

p.src: 16  to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

en: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
u.src: 16  to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

p.src: 17  nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

en: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
u.src: 17  nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

p.src: 18  Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
u.src: 18  Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

p.src: 19  But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

en: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
u.src: 19  But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

p.src: 20  Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

en: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
u.src: 20  Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

en: 1:20 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 21  Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

en: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
u.src: 21  Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

p.src: 22  I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

en: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
u.src: 22  I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

p.src: 23  but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

en: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
u.src: 23  but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

p.src: 24  So they glorified God in me.

en: So they glorified God in me.
u.src: 24  So they glorified God in me.
